name: @qu/bootstrap
description: Qu V5: the Mountpoint/Adapter-Registry and bootstrapSpace() - declarative, parameter-driven wiring of a Space's identity/transport/storage/volatileStorage to named, pluggable adapters (see docs/bootstrap-adapter-registry.md), instead of a deployment hardcoding which concrete adapter classes it imports. Depends only on @qu/core/@qu/space-core/@qu/events - never on a specific transport/storage implementation; callers register the adapters they actually want bundled.
